_about: A small, hand-written rule pack used by the prototype. The rules are basic accounting identities and presence checks of the kind MBRS validation performs. They are NOT SSM's official formula linkbase; loading the official SSMxT2022 calculation and formula linkbases is on the roadmap.

equations.title: Non-current assets add up
equations.basis: Total non-current assets must equal the sum of its line items.

equations.title: Current assets add up
equations.basis: Total current assets must equal inventories plus trade receivables plus cash and bank balances.

equations.title: Total assets add up
equations.basis: Total assets must equal non-current assets plus current assets.

equations.title: Equity adds up
equations.basis: Total equity must equal share capital plus retained earnings.

equations.title: Non-current liabilities add up
equations.basis: Total non-current liabilities must equal the sum of its line items.

equations.title: Current liabilities add up
equations.basis: Total current liabilities must equal trade payables plus current borrowings.

equations.title: Total liabilities add up
equations.basis: Total liabilities must equal non-current plus current liabilities.

equations.title: Equity and liabilities add up
equations.basis: Total equity and liabilities must equal total equity plus total liabilities.

equations.title: Balance sheet balances
equations.basis: Total assets must equal total equity and liabilities.

equations.title: Gross profit adds up
equations.basis: Gross profit must equal revenue less cost of sales.

equations.title: Profit before tax adds up
equations.basis: Profit before tax must equal gross profit plus other income less administrative expenses and finance costs.

equations.title: Profit for the year adds up
equations.basis: Profit for the year must equal profit before tax less income tax expense.

required_sections.basis: A statutory declaration must be included with the financial statements.

signs.basis: Assets, liabilities and revenue are shown as positive amounts; expenses are shown in brackets (negative).
